local_prevalidation_findings_before_repa.note: Values were viewed only after the immutable candidate/grid/split/gate contract was committed. They must not be used to alter candidate definitions, parameter grids, split roles, or thresholds in this research version.

implementation_repairs_after_local_outpu.issue: Local prevalidation initially computed total-goal distribution over 29 exact totals and used a custom marginal L1 diagnostic under the ECE name.
implementation_repairs_after_local_outpu.repair: Use the already-frozen V3.1.1 score-diagnostics convention: seven total-goal classes 0,1,2,3,4,5,6+; category LogLoss/Brier/RPS plus classwise 10-bin multiclass ECE.

implementation_repairs_after_local_outpu.issue: Initial local C gate evaluation omitted enforcement of the already-frozen worst-league-season conditional-score LogLoss degradation gate.
implementation_repairs_after_local_outpu.repair: Enforce that pre-existing contract gate in the authoritative evaluator.

implementation_repairs_after_local_outpu.issue: Initial evaluator did not include Formal V2, weak-home/weak-away, calendar-half, uncertainty and process-active/fallback breakdowns in the final result object even though the research brief required them.
implementation_repairs_after_local_outpu.repair: Add reporting-only breakdowns without changing model fit, parameter selection, or gates.
